notes: New: Bookmarks. Save the exact moment you are at inside a podcast episode, an on-device song or video, or a YouTube video, and jump straight back to it later. The bookmark button sits in the player - the mini player on Podcasts, the full player on Media Player - and each screen's top bar carries the list of what you have saved, badged with a count. A bookmark can be given a name, or left as its timestamp, and tapping one starts that item at that second even after the app has been closed and reopened, whether or not the show or folder it came from is still on screen. Podcasts and Media Player keep separate lists, and tapping the button twice by accident will not leave you two bookmarks five seconds apart. Also new: download a YouTube video or its audio - the full player's download button now offers the formats the video actually has. Improved: YouTube playback starts faster and falls back to public Piped servers when YouTube's own extraction fails, and the playback speed you pick is remembered between sessions. Fixed: the Media Player's full player showed no seek bar at all while a YouTube video was playing. A video's chapters, description and related videos could also come up empty after skipping from one video to the next, because the previous video's details were allowed to overwrite those of the video now playing. And closing the app could, on some devices, leave the player running with no way to reach it.
